items.reason: A gentle peptide cream suits an early, low-effort start to a firming-focused routine.
A low-strength retinal eye cream fits your request for an early anti-aging step, used at night.
Retinal makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 in the morning protects the look of your skin alongside it.

response.routine_note: Use the peptide cream morning or night, and start the retinal eye cream at night just a couple of times a week, building up as your skin gets comfortable. Apply the mineral SPF every morning, and reapply it if you are outdoors for long.
